rows.en:
No, it's nothing...
That's it for today. It's getting late. Go home.
No, but...
Can't you do as your teacher says?
(Hilda-sensei... I wonder what happened back then...)
(Unwinding with Hilda-sensei again today.)
Oh, \p-chan, did I keep you waiting?
rows.notes: Hilda, female version only; joking (male version c05813).

rows.en: That's definitely true.
(What's she up to...?)

I'm a girl, though...
Oh well... One big bite!
rows.notes: Female only; answers 'bite into it like a man'.

rows.en: (Oh, it's tasty! The sausage is super juicy!)
(Yeah, the veggies are nicely balanced too, I think.)
No, it's nothing really.
(Hilda-sensei... I wonder what happened back then...)
(I was supposed to go out with Hilda-sensei today...)

No, I haven't been waiting at all.
So, where are we going today?

Hm... let's see...
Well, leave it to me.
Phew. Well, shall we head back now?

Sure.
Thanks for everything again today!
Heh. I had fun too. See you.

(So Hilda-sensei had fun too.
That kinda makes me happy.)
(I was supposed to go out with Hilda-sensei today...)

No, I haven't been waiting at all.
So, where are we going today?

(So Hilda-sensei had fun too.
That kinda makes me happy.)

(Training today, for the first time in a while.
Well, at Island 3 it'll feel great.)
Hey, \p, sorry to keep you waiting!

I see. Then let's get started right away.
There's plenty of open space today,
so we should get some good training in.

Mm, good answer.
Today I'll be even tougher on you than usual.
So get fired up!
Yes, I came prepared!
(Even tougher than usual... *gulp*...)
Heh. Just kidding.

You're an idiot, now and forever.
We come all the way out here, and you think we'd train?!
...Meaning?

We're at a resort, for once! We're here to unwind.
It's a vacation, obviously!
(Whoa, dazzling!)
rows.notes: Male only; reacting to Hilda in beachwear.

rows.en: Come on, today we play as hard as we can. Follow me!
Come on, catch me if you can!
Sensei, wait for me!

Come on, over here!
Yes, that's it!
Senseeei, wait for me! Senseeei!
Not yet, not yet! Ahahaha!
Shenshe~e... wai' fo'...
rows.notes: Both genders; out-of-breath slurring of 'sensei, matte kudasai', cut off.

rows.en: How pathetic. Are you even trying?
*Pant, pant*...
(Sensei's going at full speed, after all...)
Oh, honestly, you're hopeless. Rest here for a bit.
*Pant, pant* Sorry...
Now, maybe I'll join in on that.
rows.notes: Hilda; 'that' is an unseen beach activity.

rows.en: Watch closely from there. I'll show you my skills.
Her skills at what...?
All right!
rows.notes: x6: Hilda, also Pinon in frd_pnn_107.

rows.en: Ooh!
Not yet!
Ooooooooh!
Hah!
Damn, that lady's incredible! Who is she?!

Phew, I really can't move like I used to
after such a long break.
No, no, that's not true at all!
No, I know my own body well.
...Is that how it works...?

Back when I was a duo with that one,
I could move much more...
rows.notes: Hilda; 'aitsu' (a past partner, gender not given) kept neutral as 'that one'.

rows.en: Sensei, who's 'that one'?
Hm? Ah, just talking to myself. Never mind...

Prying into my past? That's cheeky of you.
Since when did you get so high and mighty?
No, I never meant it like that...

Well, fine. Forget that, let's enjoy the present.
Come on! That one's next!
Sensei! Wait, I'm still worn out from before...
That was pretty fun today.
Yes, it was, Sensei.

'You play hard like this so you can work hard
tomorrow'... Huh, that's another thing
that one used to say...
rows.notes: Hilda; 'aitsu' kept neutral as in c05920.

rows.en: ...Sensei?
Right, that's it for today. See you.
(Sensei seemed a little off somehow...)

(Training today, for the first time in a while.
Well, at Island 3 it should feel nice, I guess.)
rows.notes: Female only; the Japanese second line starts with an indent space, dropped.

rows.en: Yes! I came prepared!
(Even tougher than usual... Will I be okay...?)
...Meaning?
(Hilda-sensei... wow...)
rows.notes: Female only; reacting to Hilda in beachwear.

rows.en: Sensei, wait up!
Hah... hah...
(Sensei's going full speed, after all...)

uncertain: c05920/c05921/c05929: Hilda's past partner 'aitsu' is not identified and has no gender in the scene; rendered 'that one' ('Sensei, who's 'that one'?') to avoid assuming he/she.
c05907/c05925: 'are' (that thing she joins) is an unseen beach activity; kept as 'that'.
